name: 5Point Nation Crips
description: The 5Point Nation Crips (5PN) is a neighborhood-based Crip-affiliated street gang alliance operating in Detroit's Five Points area on the city's far northwest side, documented as beginning to form between 2015 and 2016. Rather than functioning as a single centralized gang, it operates as a loose coalition of smaller crews and cliques that share territory, symbolism, and identity. The alliance traces its origins to two youth graffiti crews—the Bloc Side Soldiers and the North Side Soldiers—whose overlapping membership and territory gradually coalesced into a broader neighborhood identity.

sources.title: Inside the Powerful Rise of 5Point Nation Crips (5PN) in Detroit
Decoding 5Point Nation: Detroit's Crip Alliance Misread by Outsiders
